definitions.gloss: divorce notification form (filed at a city office)
definitions.explanation: The official form that a couple submits to the city, ward, town or village office to register a divorce. Both spouses sign it, along with two adult witnesses, and the divorce takes effect when the office accepts it.

examples.japanese: {離婚届|りこんとどけ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}した→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
{離婚届|りこんとどけ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{判|はん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{押|お}す→押す：02854_osu⟧。
examples.english: She stamps her seal on the divorce form.

examples.japanese: ⟦{妻|つま}→妻：01005_tsuma⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{署名|しょめい}→署名：03682_shomei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{済|す}ませた→済む：01950_sumu⟧{離婚届|りこんとどけ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{机|つくえ}→机：00762_tsukue⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{置|お}いて→置く：01092_oku⟧⟦{出|で}て→出る：00513_deru⟧いった。
examples.english: My wife left a divorce form, already signed, on the desk and walked out.

notes:
{届|とどけ} is a notification filed with the authorities, as in ⟦{婚姻届|こんいんとどけ}→婚姻届：22413_konintodoke⟧ (marriage registration) and ⟦{出生届|しゅっしょうとどけ}→出生届：32040_shusshoutodoke⟧ (birth registration). The form is also written {離婚届|りこんとど}け, with the okurigana.
